name: The dark side of light thought
source:
"I really hoped to help."



I don't really know if she knows or not

But I left some things in her jewelry box

And she's wearing out my rings

Taking the compliments meant for me

And although I think I'll miss them

At least there's proof of my existence

A captive little soldier on her fingers

Deep behind enemy lines

[From [url=https://lirikachyan.itch.io/the-dark-side-of-light-thought-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我真的希望能帮上忙。”

我不太清楚，她究竟知不知道。

但我在她的首饰盒里，留下了一些东西。

她戴着我的戒指，渐渐将它们磨损。

收下那些原本属于我的赞美。

虽然我想，我会怀念它们。

至少，还有证据证明我存在过。

她指间一名被俘的小兵。

深陷敌后。

[摘自[url=https://lirikachyan.itch.io/the-dark-side-of-light-thought-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
